plain: This story is about the Tic Tac, a white oval object shaped like the mint, which a Navy fighter pilot named David Fravor says he saw in 2004 off the coast of California while flying from the aircraft carrier Nimitz. A UFO activist named Steven Greer says that some years ago he met Fravor, who told him the object had to be alien. Greer says he answered, "Sir, with all due respect," it was made by the Lockheed Skunk Works, the secret advanced aircraft division of the defence company Lockheed. In a second telling on the same podcast, hosted by Jesse Michels, Greer adds that such craft are kept hidden on purpose from the top military command, so that when a pilot like Fravor runs into one, the military does not know it is ours. A journalist named Ross Coulthart tells a similar version on a later episode, saying he now knows "categorically" that the Tic Tac is Lockheed Martin technology, though he names no source and does not mention Fravor or Greer. If true, it would mean one of the most famous UFO sightings was a secret human aircraft hidden even from the military's own leaders.
